reasons.ENGINEERING_UI_COMPLETE: This means the engineering UI shell is complete; it does not mean a real map, MapLibre, or Cesium is complete.
reasons.ENGINEERING_UI_SHELL_COMPLETE: The reviewed 2D shell is implemented with synthetic SVG schematics and explicit evidence-state labels.
reasons.TWO_D_IMPLEMENTATION: The current 2D view is a SYNTHETIC_SVG_SCHEMATIC, not a real-map connection.
reasons.REAL_MAP_COMPLETE: No city has a complete real-map geometry layer.
reasons.KIYOMIZU_REAL_ARTIFACT_CAPABILITY: Kiyomizu has a hash-bound source-traceable VGI corridor artifact; this is not a viewer or model connection.
reasons.KIYOMIZU_CANDIDATE_GRAPH_AVAILABLE: Kiyomizu has a 21-node/19-edge candidate graph with two components and route continuity NOT_ESTABLISHED.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_ARTIFACTS_AVAILABLE: PARTIAL means Kiyomizu only; Arashiyama and Fujisawa real artifacts are not integrated in this reviewed checkpoint.
reasons.ALL_THREE_CITIES_REAL_GEOMETRY: The reviewed checkpoint does not contain approved real geometry for all three cities.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED: This false value is scoped to VIEWER_OR_MODEL_PIPELINE; the viewer still displays SYNTHETIC_DEMO geometry.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED_SCOPE: The global flag describes viewer or model pipeline connection, not per-city artifact validation.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED_TO_VIEWER: No real geometry artifact is loaded by the current viewer.
reasons.MODEL_CONNECTED: Candidate city-pack rows do not enter a real hazard/profile/model pipeline; M6 remains NOT_COMPUTED.
reasons.M7_CONNECTED_TO_REAL_EDGES: M7 core exists but no reviewed real/CANDIDATE edge has the required measured inputs.
reasons.KPI_CONNECTED: Demand, capacity, verified entrances, and operation evidence remain insufficient; KPI values stay reasoned null.
reasons.ADMIN_VALIDATED: Current facilities, entrances, capacities, operations, field evidence, and authority review are incomplete.
reasons.DEMO_COMPLETE: The V4 definition requires at least one real source-traceable UI geometry layer in every city.

three_dimensional_fallback: The 2D UI remains available and explicitly states that 3D is unavailable.
